findings.description: The EC2 instance's user_data script contains hardcoded AWS access key ID and secret access key (AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMAAA / wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCYEXAMAAAKEY). These are stored in instance metadata and Terraform state where anyone with metadata or state access can retrieve them, and the script runs as root.
The security group allows SSH (port 22) from 0.0.0.0/0, exposing the instance to brute-force and exploitation attempts from the entire internet.
Egress is allowed to 0.0.0.0/0 on all ports and protocols, allowing unrestricted outbound traffic that aids data exfiltration and command-and-control if the instance is compromised.

map_public_ip_on_launch is true, so instances launched into this subnet automatically receive public IP addresses, increasing exposure to the internet. Combined with the open security group and IGW route this directly exposes the portal server.
map_public_ip_on_launch is true on this subnet, automatically assigning public IPs to launched instances and exposing them to the internet.
The netflow archive bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration and no aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration resource, so VPC flow log data is stored unencrypted at rest.

findings.issue_category: S3 bucket without public access block
findings.description: The bucket has no aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block and no ACL restricting access, so there is no safeguard preventing the flow-log archive from being made public.
force_destroy = true allows the bucket and all its flow log data to be deleted without error even when it contains objects, weakening data protection and tamper resistance of the audit logs.
The EBS volume has no encrypted = true attribute, so data stored on the disk is not encrypted at rest.
The EBS snapshot is created from an unencrypted volume and does not specify encryption, so backup data is stored unencrypted at rest.

findings.issue_category: Public default route to internet gateway
findings.description: A 0.0.0.0/0 route directs all traffic from the associated route table to the internet gateway, making the attached public subnets directly internet-reachable.
